leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Plural Nouns · Regular Forms
leadIn.content: Talking about more than one thing: I have one cat, but my neighbor has three cats and two dogs.

form.title: Form & Structure: Plural Nouns · Regular Forms
form.content: Most nouns: add -s (cat -> cats). Nouns ending in s, sh, ch, x: add -es (bus -> buses). Nouns ending in consonant + y: change y to -ies (baby -> babies).

controlledPractice.question: Plural of 'city'?
controlledPractice.explanation: Consonant + y → change y to ies: city → cities.

controlledPractice.question: Plural of 'knife'?
controlledPractice.explanation: Some -f/-fe words change to -ves: knife → knives.
